verdict.rationale: Check's Onboard Component lets employees sign tax forms, and the API keeps employee tax documents. That is a narrow, tax-specific form of e-signature with per-employee document storage. There is no evidence of an ops user sending offer letters or arbitrary HR documents for signature. missing for 10: sending offer letters and custom HR documents for e-signature, general per-employee HR document storage beyond tax forms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
